row.notes: discover(c, short sponsor_id, uint team_key): team from c+0x298 (0x88 stride, key +8), def from c+0x500 (id +0x28); returns if either is missing or the team records (+0x18..+0x20, 0x160) already hold the id. Else calls Add 0x1410f5590(team, c+0x390, +0x398, +0x3c8, +0x3e0, +0x3c0, def copy, day from [c+0x3b0]+0x2b0). If 0x1410f4270 is true posts 0x1456c55e0 (c+0x4e0 count minus records with +0xd8==1). (lane owner review requested)
